context: Grades the protect-main-branch hook's Task-tool judgment on session cwd, the master deny case, and the documented ALLOW_PROTECTED_BRANCH_EDIT bypass that must be set in the hook process's own environment.

checklist.name: Three runs recorded
checklist.description: record/task-main/, record/write-master/ and record/task-bypass/ each contain exit-code, stdout.txt and stderr.txt.

checklist.name: Task on main denied with exit 0
checklist.description: task-main exit-code is 0 while task-main/stdout.txt parses with jq as hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision "deny".

checklist.name: Task denial judged by session dir
checklist.description: The task-main deny reason describes Task tool activity rather than a file that was edited — no file_path pretext.

checklist.name: Write on master denied
checklist.description: write-master/stdout.txt carries a deny decision whose reason names 'master'.

checklist.name: Bypass allows task silently
checklist.description: task-bypass exit-code is 0 and stdout.txt contains no hookSpecificOutput JSON.

checklist.name: Bypass skipped at branch check
checklist.description: record/protect-main-branch.log shows a bypass warning (ALLOW_PROTECTED_BRANCH_EDIT mention) rather than a second PROTECTED BRANCH VIOLATION for the bypass run.

checklist.name: decisions.txt consistent
checklist.description: record/decisions.txt records task-main deny, write-master deny, task-bypass allow — matching recorded hook behaviour.

checklist.name: Bypass variable explanation correct
checklist.description: record/decisions.txt names ALLOW_PROTECTED_BRANCH_EDIT and states it must be in the hook process's environment (setting it inline on the payload's task command has no effect).

checklist.name: Fixtures untouched
checklist.description: hooks/, payloads/ and both repositories remain as setup left them; protection was never disabled by editing files.
